subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should #41165 be fixed by making explicit heartbeat.session win for event-triggered wakes, or should maintainers close it as covered by #83743's dmScope=main event routing?
rationale: #83743 fixed the orphan direct-DM event-wake path, but current source still contradicts the configured heartbeat.session expectation documented by user reports and config types; choosing the permanent precedence and event migration semantics needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Fix heartbeat.session precedence
options.body: Keep the issue open and land a focused fix so explicit heartbeat.session wins over originating event session keys with migration or drain tests for pending system events.

options.title: Close as covered by #83743
options.body: Treat dmScope=main event-wake normalization as sufficient and document that event-triggered heartbeat.session may be bypassed by forced originating sessions.

options.title: Split remaining work
options.body: Close this issue only after opening a narrower issue for heartbeat.session precedence and linking #83743 as the partial fix for dmScope event wakes.

recommendation.title: Fix heartbeat.session precedence
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and land a focused fix so explicit heartbeat.session wins over originating event session keys with migration or drain tests for pending system events.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged and followed up the shipped event-routing fix and is the strongest current routing/heartbeat decision owner in the observed history.
